citations.claim: Total energy at first violating step exceeds E0+10%+5J bound
Light floor body ejected downward at extreme speed after squeeze between heavy body and floor
Energy was still within bound one step before, showing sudden injection at squeeze

counterfactual.change: Changed heavy body (body 0) restitution e from 1 to 0 only; same 14 steps. Elastic squeeze removed so no energy injection and no violation.

explanation: Heavy body (m=1,r=1.2) falls onto light body (m=0.2,r=0.2) resting near floor y=0. Both contacts (floor-circle and circle-circle) with e=1 are resolved in same step with impulse plus positional correction. Sequential elastic impulses in a three-body squeeze plus depenetration add net kinetic energy: light body goes from speed ~0.6 at step13 to ~42.4 at step14 and heavy body speeds up from ~23.3 to downward 18.5 in same interval, raising total energy from ~359.9 to ~416.2 above allowed 396.6 with zero controller work. Removing elasticity on one body removes the violation.
vision_note: A large circle falls straight down onto a tiny circle resting just above the floor. By step 14 the large circle crushes the tiny circle against the floor in a tight squeeze.
